Clara (partnerships): Heads up — Centauri Incubator pilot kickoff. NDA signed by Centauri legal this morning. Proposed scope: 2-week lab soak, power/thermal sweep, perf-per-watt, and tail-latency on LLM_XXL. Need owners for bench harness, shipping, and marketplace messaging.
Jyoti (solutions): Can we keep marketplace listing on hold for the pilot? Want pilot -> private GA path. Also need confirmed consent for any customer traces.
Matt R (eng-ml): I can own the model harness. Which variants do we test? FP16, INT8 dynamic, and the new 4-bit profile? Will need container image + kernel flags.
Sergio (benchmarks): Bench plan suggestion: static prompt suite, sanitized customer trace, and 24h stress soak. Capture p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU util, power (W), thermal delta. Add a quick rerank microbench.
Kai (eng-infra): Labs booking note — Centauri asked for hardware slot next Tue. Shipping ETA 48h after we send handoff. Who has shipping labels and customs details?
labs-bot: Lab slot requested: centauri-1, tentative Tue 10:00. Approvers: @Clara, @Kai.
Clara (partnerships): Assigning owners: Matt -> harness + container, Sergio -> bench config + dashboards, Jyoti -> privacy & marketplace gating, Kai -> shipping + rack prep. I'll draft partner email and schedule kickoff.
Matt R (eng-ml): Quick run snippet (draft):

``
./bench_runner --model LLM_XXL_fp16 --quant dynamic --batch 8 --seq 2048 --trace /mnt/traces/customerA.json
```

Also need KV-cache warmup script and a CI job for the quant kernels.
Sergio (benchmarks): Dashboard fields: tokens/sec, avg latency, p95, p99, gpu_mem, power_watts, temp_plate. I'll provide a baseline JSON schema for telemetry and add regression alerts.
Jyoti (solutions): Privacy note: customer traces must be redacted. Use `trace_sanitizer.py --remove-ips --hash-user-ids`. Sharing consent template and legal checklist now. Marketplace listing remains blocked until pilot close.
Clara (partnerships): Meeting Friday 10am PT to align. Legal flagged an SCA clause change required in section 5 of the NDA — I'll incorporate. Kai, confirm if lab HSM can be used for keys during the pilot.
Kai (eng-infra): Lab HSM available (airgapped slot) but requires request form. Filling it out now and booking on our side.
labs-bot: NDA signature recorded: Centauri legal signed at 1755123478. Document: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/centauri/nda-v1 (internal).
Matt R (eng-ml): Heads up — 4-bit quant profile needs a new kernel path; may require extra CI and could introduce perf regressions. Flagging potential delays.
Sergio (benchmarks): :thumbsup: I'll add regression alerts: if p95 >= baseline * 1.15 then auto-notify eng-ml and partnerships.
Clara (partnerships): Summary action items:
- Matt: deliver harness + container by Thu EOD
- Sergio: dashboard + baseline JSON by Thu EOD
- Jyoti: consent template + marketplace hold by Wed
- Kai: shipping labels + HSM request by Wed
I'll post the Centauri kickoff invite once we have harness ETA. Thanks everyone.
